Enforce GitHub MCP repository and organization containment

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-6
  description: |-
    The GitHub MCP proxy previously required an explicit repository coordinate and forwarded arguments and results unchanged, so organization leases and credential reads could not be contained independently of the prompt. Classify each call, normalize bounded search qualifiers onto the structured lease, inspect organization-wide results before release, and tag catalog, action, and audit identities with the lease scope.
